title: The Visitor of Marrow Creek
author: Gideon Zhou
blurb: Ada Vane, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. But when the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must return what was taken in 1974 before the harvest moon rises.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
